title: Miracles and Deliverance at The River Church
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he brings the power of God to life in this incredible sermon, where lives are transformed and miraculous healings take place. You'll witness the anointing of the Holy Spirit as Pastor Chris prays for individuals, casting out demons and breaking curses, and you'll be inspired to experience the love and redemption of Jesus Christ for yourself. This is a must-listen for anyone seeking a deeper connection with God and a greater understanding of His power to heal and deliver.
